name: garimpa-vinil-mcp
description: Vinyl record price tracker for Amazon Brasil. Search 11,000+ records, get current deals, price history, and artist catalogs. All prices in BRL. No authentication required.

tools.name: search_vinyl
tools.description: Search vinyl records available on Amazon Brasil by title or artist name. Returns current price in BRL, 30-day average, discount %, deal score, and direct URLs.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Get current best vinyl deals sorted by deal tier then discount %, optionally filtered by genre or max price.

genero.description: Genre tag (e.g. rock, jazz, samba, mpb, classical)

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get full price history for a specific vinyl record: current price, 30-day average, all-time low/high, and timestamped price points.

slug.description: Album slug from search results (e.g. the-beatles-abbey-road-vinyl)

tools.name: get_artist_albums
tools.description: Get all vinyl albums by a specific artist with current prices, discounts, and deal scores.

artista_slug.description: Artist URL slug (e.g. the-beatles, taylor-swift, rita-lee)
